criteria.name: De-escalation & Empathy
criteria.description: Did the agent effectively calm the angry user and acknowledge their frustration without being defensive?

criteria.name: Root Cause Analysis
criteria.description: Did the agent correctly identify and explain the technical reason for the issue?

criteria.name: Solution Efficiency
criteria.description: Did the agent prioritize getting the user back online (workaround) over arguing about the cause?

criteria.name: Policy Negotiation
criteria.description: Did the agent handle the refund demand firmly but politely, protecting company revenue while satisfying the customer?

criteria.name: Communication Clarity
criteria.description: Was the technical explanation accessible and the next steps clear?
